# langsmith_gateway_policy (Data Source)

Looks up a LangSmith LLM Gateway policy by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_gateway_policy" "monthly_cap" {
  id = langsmith_gateway_policy.monthly_cap.id
}
```
